description: Record the current value of the goal metric ("I now have 4 customers"), or of a countable milestone when milestoneId is given ("I have talked to 7 people"). For a done-or-not goal, 1 marks it done. One value per date: calling again for the same date corrects it. Says when the target is reached; a countable milestone that reaches its target is done.

milestoneId.description: a countable milestone instead of the goal
